gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-asta-sans: Every curve in Balsamiq Sans looks cut from one stencil channel, never pinched. Asta Sans follows in tubelike, constant lines, so the two feel like friendly siblings, one shouting and the other chatting.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-bai-jamjuree: Bai Jamjuree keeps its round letters light and unpinched, with no thick-and-thin shifts anywhere. Over a long page, Bai Jamjuree reads smoothly beside the bolder Balsamiq Sans heading, a plain sans that never fusses or tires the eye.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-barlow: Rounded, loud and hand-cut in feel, Balsamiq Sans sets up Barlow, whose neon-tube strokes keep every line the same width. Friendly throughout.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-biz-udgothic: Balsamiq Sans draws every glyph with zero stroke contrast, like bent tubing. BIZ UDGothic sits beneath it with a wide channel into each bowl, sans-serif and modern, so the loud top and the tidy text feel related but not identical.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-biz-udpgothic: Each Balsamiq Sans glyph looks drawn with a single pen tip, simple and bold, with no pinched curves anywhere. BIZ UDPGothic, a sans-serif with lavish spacing, reads loosely and gently.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-bpmf-huninn: Balsamiq Sans holds a stencil-channel line from start to finish, with no tight turns in its curves anywhere. Bpmf Huninn matches that single-weight outline feel.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-st: Bpmf Zihi Kai Std keeps its counters connected to the outside and swells only slightly in curves. Balsamiq Sans has almost no stroke contrast, so Bpmf Zihi Kai Std brings the sans text a gentle pressure of robust downstrokes and slender turns beneath it.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-cairo: Balsamiq Sans bends its lines like rope or tubing, bold and expressive in a way that grabs a headline. Cairo does the opposite job, a plain sans with a wide channel into every bowl that keeps text modern and tidy.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-cambay: Balsamiq Sans draws a plain, unshaded line that never swells. Cambay's rounds gap like a cracked bangle, so a long sans page feels modern, light and quietly open beneath it.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-cantarell: Balsamiq Sans pours out bold, tubelike curves with nothing pinched or tight in them. Cantarell answers with c tips pulled well apart and arches that match their stems, which gives the sans-serif pairing its friendly clarity.
